issues.t: Overheating from a failed cooling fan
issues.sym: The temperature gauge climbs in traffic or hot weather, and the A/C may blow warm at the same time. You may notice the electric fan never comes on.
issues.why: The electric cooling fans or their wiring fail on the SSR. GM issued bulletins for 5.3L overheating, for overheating with an inoperative cooling fan, and for fan fuse and circuit damage caused by jump-starting the truck the wrong way.
issues.next: Watch the gauge and stop if it nears red. Have the fan motor, fuse, relay and wiring checked, and only jump-start using the proper points in the owner's manual.

issues.t: Retractable hardtop won't open or close
issues.sym: The power top stops partway, won't move, or the display shows a time-out message. Trouble codes B1517 or B1518 may be stored.
issues.why: The retractable hardtop relies on motors, sensors and a control module. GM issued bulletins for an inoperative top with a time-out message and for a folding top that stops working with these codes. A stuck top is the most reported SSR problem on RepairPal.
issues.next: Don't force the top by hand. A dealer or a shop familiar with the SSR can read the body codes and check the top sensors and motors.

issues.t: Gauges or speedometer act up
issues.sym: The speedometer reads wrong, the needles stick, peg or drop to zero, or several gauges stop working at once.
issues.why: The instrument cluster's gauge motors can fail, and owners report replacing speedometer motors or the whole cluster. RepairPal lists speedometer problems among the SSR's common complaints.
issues.next: Have the cluster tested. Repair shops can often rebuild a cluster with new gauge motors for less than a new one.

issues.t: Low beams and daytime lights suddenly go out
issues.sym: Both low-beam headlights and the daytime running lights go dark without warning, while the high beams still work.
issues.why: The headlamp driver module in the underhood fuse box can overheat and fail. GM addressed this on many trucks of this era, and federal safety files list the SSR among the vehicles covered.
issues.next: Use the high beams carefully only if you must get home, and have a dealer check your VIN for any open recall or special coverage on the headlamp module.

issues.t: Hood can fall on you
issues.sym: The hood slips off its prop rod or the rod bends, letting the heavy hood drop.
issues.why: Owners say the prop rod on early SSRs is too weak for the heavy hood. The 2005 model switched to gas struts.
issues.next: Hold the hood when working under it and check that the prop rod is seated. Many owners fit gas struts as an upgrade.

issues.t: Roof rattle, wind noise or water leak at the windshield header
issues.sym: A rattle above the windshield with the top up, wind noise, or water dripping into the cab.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins for header rattle with the roof closed, damaged weatherstrip, wind-noise seals and in-cab water leaks.
issues.next: Have the header weatherstrip inspected and adjusted or replaced under the bulletins.

issues.t: Wind noise at highway speed
issues.sym: Whistling or rushing air noise from the roof or doors at speed.
issues.why: GM published a wind-noise diagnosis guide specifically for the SSR because of how many seals the roof and doors use.
issues.next: A dealer can use the guide to find and adjust the leaking seal.

issues.t: Rear cargo cover won't open
issues.sym: The tonneau cover over the bed won't pop open from the key fob or the glove box switch, may open unevenly, or can open over bumps.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins for a cargo cover that won't open, a cover that won't open after a dead battery, uneven opening, and the cover popping open over bumps.
issues.next: Check the battery first, then have the release actuator and wiring checked under the bulletins.

issues.t: Transmission slips, loses gears or loses drive
issues.sym: No 3rd or 4th gear, harsh or wrong shifts, slipping into neutral, clunking, or a check engine light.
issues.why: GM issued a bulletin for the 4-speed automatic losing 3rd and 4th gear or drive altogether, and owners report repeat transmission failures.
issues.next: Have the codes read and the fluid checked. If it slips or loses drive, stop driving hard and get it diagnosed.

issues.t: Buzz or squawk from the automatic transmission
issues.sym: A buzzing noise or a squawk or grunt on the 2-3 upshift.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins for a buzz caused by overfilled transmission fluid and a squawk on the 2-3 shift.
issues.next: Have the fluid level checked at the correct temperature; overfilling is a common cause.

issues.t: ABS light on from a bad brake module ground
issues.sym: The ABS light comes on with codes C0265, C0201 or U1041.
issues.why: GM issued a bulletin tracing these codes to a poor ground connection for the electronic brake control module.
issues.next: Normal brakes still work, but anti-lock may be off. Ask the shop to check the module ground before replacing parts.

issues.t: Parking brake won't release
issues.sym: The parking brake stays partly on after you release it, causing drag or a burning smell from the rear brakes.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins for a parking brake that may not release after it is applied, and for resurfacing the parking brake drum inside the rear rotor.
issues.next: Don't drive with the brake dragging. Have the rear parking brake shoes and drum surface serviced.

issues.t: Oil pressure gauge jumps around
issues.sym: The oil pressure gauge reads erratically or not at all, sometimes with codes P0522 or P0523.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins for an erratic or inoperative oil pressure gauge, which is usually a faulty oil pressure sensor.
issues.next: Confirm real oil pressure with a mechanical gauge before replacing the sensor, to rule out an engine problem.

issues.t: No heat or HVAC controls act up
issues.sym: No heat, air coming from the wrong vents, or clicking from behind the dash, sometimes after repeated actuator repairs.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins for no heat or erratic HVAC controls and for repeat replacement of HVAC actuators.
issues.next: Have the codes and actuators checked. Ask about the bulletins before paying for the same actuator again.

issues.t: Blower motor dead, stuck on or noisy
issues.sym: The fan won't run, keeps running with the truck off, or makes noise on the second speed.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins for an inoperative or always-on blower motor and blower noise on speed two.
issues.next: A shop can test the blower motor and its control module.

issues.t: Door won't open from the inside handle
issues.sym: Pulling the inside handle does nothing, so you can't get out without opening the window and using the outside handle.
issues.why: GM issued a bulletin for doors that won't open from the inside handle, and owners report the handle failing and parts being hard to find.
issues.next: Get it repaired quickly; being unable to open a door from inside is a safety issue.

issues.t: Door-ajar light, window or alarm acts up
issues.sym: The door-ajar light stays on with the doors shut, the windows don't drop and rise properly when opening doors, courtesy lights stay on, or the alarm goes off by itself.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins for these door switch and window indexing problems.
issues.next: Have the door ajar switches and window indexing checked under the bulletins.

issues.t: No-start with theft codes P1626 or P1631
issues.sym: The engine cranks but won't start or starts and dies, with codes P1626 or P1631.
issues.why: These codes mean the anti-theft system did not send the correct password to the engine computer. GM issued a bulletin for this no-start.
issues.next: A dealer can check the theft system and reprogram modules if needed.

issues.t: Fuel smell from a cracked fuel tank check valve
issues.sym: Fuel smell around the truck, or fuel spitting back when you fill up.
issues.why: The check valve in the fuel tank fill inlet can crack and let fuel vapor and droplets escape. GM created a special coverage program that lists the 2003-2004 SSR.
issues.next: Ask a dealer whether the special coverage still applies to your VIN.

issues.t: Paint on the hardtop gets scuffed
issues.sym: Scratches or scuffs on the painted roof panels.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins for the roof molding rubbing the painted hardtop and for scratched front and rear roof panels.
issues.next: A dealer can replace the molding and refinish the panel.

issues.t: Catalytic converter failure
issues.sym: Check engine light, a rotten-egg smell, or loss of power at high mileage.
issues.why: CarComplaints lists catalytic converter failure among the top 2004 SSR problems, at around 125,000 miles.
issues.next: Have the codes read; a misfire or oil burning can ruin a new converter, so fix the cause first.
